summary: Solid Pester test suite covering all main functions (Get-SemanticVersion, Get-CommitBumpType, Get-NextVersion, New-ChangelogEntry, Set-SemanticVersion, Invoke-VersionBump). Error cases and breaking-change markers tested; workflow structure validated against YAML spec and actionlint. Minor gaps: no tests for malformed JSON in package.json, empty commits array, Unicode in commit messages, or case-sensitivity edge cases. Missing direct tests of CLI entry point Invoke-Bump.ps1. Tests use TestDrive idiomatically and are well-organized, but setup patterns could be more consistent. Would catch most regressions; good regression protection for core functionality.
